test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 21th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Calculate the compound interest for a principal of 16000 over a period of 2 years at an annual rate of 10%.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = 16000

Time (T) = 2 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = Amount (A) - Principal (P)

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)T

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount (A) = 16000 × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ Amount (A) = 16000 × (1 + 0.1)²

⇒ Amount (A) = 16000 × (1.1)²

⇒ Amount (A) = 16000 × 1.21

⇒ Amount (A) = 19360

⇒ Compound Interest (CI) = Amount (A) - Principal (P)

⇒ Compound Interest (CI) = 19360 - 16000

⇒ Compound Interest (CI) = 3360

**∴ The correct answer is 3360.**
